input.body:
Hello Priya,

Thanks for your enquiry about a GenAI workshop for your operations managers. We run hands-on AI corporate workshops, and we would be glad to help your team of about 40 people in Pune during the week of 17 November.

Given Acme Logistics' work across western India and the recent opening of your cold-chain hub in Nagpur, we could tailor the sessions to practical questions your managers face, such as route planning with AI and demand forecasting.

Could we have a 20-minute call this week to talk through your goals and what would work best for the group?

Best regards,
Ann Rao
